_meta.description: YOY Unified AI Model Registry — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. All provider/model data verified from official provider websites July 2026. Covers LLM chat, image gen, video gen, audio/TTS/STT, web search, embeddings, and music generation. Rebuilt 2026-08-23: legacy models hidden, specialists removed from chat, current models verified from official websites. | v5.8.2: zai vision-routing fix, coding-plan support per docs.z.ai (2026-09-16) | v5.8.4: web-search capability matrix verified per provider (docs.z.ai web_search, docs.claude.com web_search tool, xAI live search, DashScope enable_search); Perplexity sonar + Z.AI GLM + Anthropic Claude now search-enabled on the same chat key. | v5.8.5: specialist-surface cleanup — dead/never-existed ids hidden (dall-e-3 removed 2026-05-12, dall-e-4/sora-turbo/veo-4 non-existent, imagen-3.0 shut down, lyria-2/3 superseded by Lyria 3.5). | v5.9.0 (schema v1): LOCKED SCHEMA - fixed vocabulary, required fields and cross-field invariants; emoji derived deterministically for every model; every visible model declares pricing provenance (costIn/costOut/costTier/costUnit, or costUnit=unknown + unverified flag); category aliases and legacy field names normalised; validated by scripts/validate-registry.js and enforced by the auto-updater publish gate. Spec: src/ai/REGISTRY-SCHEMA.md | v5.9.1: official Z.AI and Alibaba Model Studio audit for GLM-5.3/Flash/FlashX and Qwen3.8 Max/Flash.
